plainEnglish.summary: Where audio plays automatically, users can pause it, stop it, and adjust its volume separately from the system volume. All three are required, which is stricter than WCAG 2.2's 1.4.2, where any one of them is enough.
plainEnglish.whyItMatters: Background audio masks a screen reader's speech, making the page unusable until it stops - and the system volume control turns off both at once.
